method: Task-adaptive fine-tuning of partition-specific v27 multi-task directed-bond networks, with unweighted BCE, pairwise ranking, and original-head distillation. Compare original graph and fine-tuned graph against reconstructed v45.
selection: Train every listed task on official-valid and all three scaffold folds. Weight valid 0.20 and CV mean 0.80 minus 0.05 CV SD; require CV mean>0.0005, objective>0.0005 and two positive folds. Permit task/fold declines. Freeze choices before final refit.
baseline_correction: Replay selected v44 continuous-task changes before exact local v45 exported blend choices; previous v45 analysis used pre-v44 arrays. Use the submitted local v45 hash, never stale remote v45 exports.
limitations: Official aggregate formula unknown. Valid and scaffold CV historically reused; baseline CV remains a historical proxy. Neither validation gains nor score trajectory guarantees a leaderboard gain. Existing representation provenance is unchanged; no new external data downloaded.
